items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: Roy Evans, Sun Handy, Lee Collie, myself, Joe Robo Show. And that was all.

ctx.x: Why he got off of that, I don't know. And that was the bad consistor. Roy Evans, Sun Handy, Lee Collie, myself, Joe Robo Show. And that was all. No, Plectum. We called the guy Plectum. That'd be one of the greatest band you play around here. I'll see his name, and I'll see if I can think his name now. I called him Plectum, because he's one of them Plectum guitars. Five-string guitars. Panties now. What is that little fellow man now? He turned out to be one of the greatest. He's in New York now. New York's 12-8.…
Yeah, well, did he play with Lee Collin's at the Astoria too? Yeah. The same banjo player? Yeah. Well, he had a couple of them there. He had Rene Hall and he had Rene Hall. Rene Hall. That's it.
